entries.title: Capability guide and automatic coverage checks
entries.where: Repository README → capabilities and user guide; bookmark docs/CAPABILITIES.md.
entries.behavior: Reviewed walkthroughs explain features, exact entry points, limitations and observable tests. The command/gesture inventory regenerates from the application registries. Builds and model checks reject missing command coverage and stale generated guidance.

steps.do: Open the repository README and follow capabilities and user guide. Search for Interpretive frame declarations.
steps.expect: Its location, scoped tri-state behavior and explicit lack of constraint enforcement are visible.

steps.do: Follow a capability’s numbered test and compare each expected result.
steps.expect: You can report the stable capability ID and the failing step without reconstructing chat history.

steps.do: For contributors: run node --run docs:capabilities, then node --run check:capabilities.
steps.expect: The generated guide is current and every registered command/gesture has walkthrough coverage.

entries.status: Implemented; generator and coverage checks verified
entries.limits: Repository guide only; no in-app guide viewer yet. Automation checks coverage/freshness, not whether a human walkthrough or browser behavior is correct.

verification.browser: Not applicable to repository-only guide generation
verification.automated: Generator and check command run; model suite validation recorded in delivery

entries.title: Active context, close, minimize, resize and descendants
entries.where: Master controller → Active context. Click the intended frame first.
entries.behavior: Actions target the clicked/focused frame. Esc steps out one field/popup level before minimizing; active MS has priority. W resizes/restores, M minimizes/restores, X closes, D toggles descendants, subject to saved bindings.

steps.do: Open a frame, click a value field, edit it, then press Esc.
steps.expect: The value edit cancels and focus returns to its parent.

steps.do: Press Esc again at frame level; reopen it. Try M, W, then W again.
steps.expect: The frame minimizes/restores; resize can restore its earlier size.

steps.do: Expand several nested sections, then invoke Expand / collapse active descendants.
steps.expect: Descendant sections collapse together. Closing preserves reopenable frames.

entries.limits: Browser acceptance has not been recorded for this guide.

verification.automated: See subsystem tests and PR checks; not proof of usability

entries.title: Universal Shift configuration
entries.where: Hold Shift and press the configured shortcut of the function you want.
entries.behavior: Only relevant MC settings appear. Repeated shortcut presses cycle choices; release Shift executes once. Right-click an option applies and locks it; left-click resets to priority 1.

steps.do: Open a frame. Hold Shift and press W repeatedly.
steps.expect: Resize options cycle and hovering previews the proposed bounds.

steps.do: Release Shift. Repeat, right-click another option, then use plain W.
steps.expect: The selected action executes; the locked choice becomes the future default.

steps.expect: A focused search field accepts text and shows relevant results.

steps.do: Activate a result and move the pointer away; press Esc through the field and popup.

steps.do: Select multiple UI controls and invoke Compact selected UI / Align UI. Undo.

entries.behavior: Recent uses chronological actions across owners; Context limits actions to the active context; Selective uses categories. Configure steps and a retained maximum of 10. MS selection has a separate transient timeline.

steps.expect: The frame move reverses before the earlier visual edit.

steps.expect: The selected history operation executes once using those settings.

steps.do: Redo, then switch atlases and undo a knowledge edit.

entries.behavior: Visual roles group backgrounds, contours, text and other repeated parts. Selection becomes the exclusive edit scope. Unapplied edits are drafts; deselecting a target rolls its draft back to applied values.

steps.do: Make another draft change and request close/minimize.
steps.expect: Existing Apply / Discard / Cancel choices blink; Apply/Discard completes the queued action and Cancel keeps editing.

entries.title: Live dependencies, frozen pins, restore and archive pruning
entries.where: Composer reference component → Dependency version; library → Dependencies / revisions.
entries.behavior: Live references follow edits. Pinned references use saved revisions with frozen dependencies. Restore creates a new revision. Pruning keeps current snapshots and required pins.

steps.do: Reuse a source in two objects. Pin one reference and leave the other live. Edit and save the source.
steps.expect: Only the live reference follows the source change.

steps.do: Select an archived revision and Restore as new revision.
steps.expect: The old structure becomes a new current revision; history is not rewritten.

steps.do: Prune unpinned history, then Undo.
steps.expect: Required pins survive; Undo restores the pruned archive.

entries.limits: 32 revisions/object, 2,048 archived recipes/workspace; missing revisions and cycles are rejected.
